title_en: My most memorable trip was to Jeju.
goal_ko: 가장 기억에 남는 일을 묻고, 이유와 함께 말하고, ‘처음’이었던 경험 말하기
offer_ko: ‘가장 기억에 남는 일’ 표현을 잠깐 익혀 볼까요?

expressions.pattern: ^what was (?:the most memorable|your most memorable|the best) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,4}?)(?: (?:youve ever had|you ever had|of your life|ever|so far))?$

ok: What was the most memorable trip you’ve ever had?
what was your most memorable day
What was the most memorable day of your life?

help.blank: My most memorable trip was to Jeju ___ I saw the sunrise.

expressions.accept_note: 이유(because)까지 말해야 목표 수행. 곳은 to/in과 함께(was to Jeju).

ok: My most memorable trip was to Jeju because I saw the sunrise.
my most memorable day was my first day at work because everyone was kind
partial: My most memorable trip was to Jeju

expressions.en: It was the first time I’d ever ___.

help.blank: It was the ___ time I’d ever seen snow.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:it was|that was) (?:the|my) first time (?:id ever|i had ever|i ever|ive ever|id|i) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8})$
expressions.accept_note: ‘It was the first time I saw …’도 인정.

ok: It was the first time I’d ever seen snow.
it was the first time I saw the sea

scene.en: Tori, what was the most memorable trip you’ve ever had?
Hmm, a winter trip to Canada. What about you?
My most memorable trip was to Jeju because I saw the sunrise.
Yes. It was the first time I’d ever climbed a mountain at night.
